GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676 (3 Jul 50) CCS
(SCAPIN-2113)
APO 500
3 July 1950
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Submarine Cable Telegraph Service Between Japan and Areas Served by the Great Northern Telegraph Company Limited
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG ▲76 .3 (3 Nov 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1811, 3 November 1947, subject: Operation of Great Northern Telegraph Company Cable Station and Facilities at Nagasaki, as amended.
b. Memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG 311 (24 Feb 50)CCS, SGAPIN 2085, 24 February 1950, subject: Rationalization of Japan's International Telecommunications Services.
2. Effective 1 July 1950 reference memorandum 1a above is rescinded.
3. The conduct of submarine cable telegraph service between Japan and areas served by the Great Northern Telegraph Company, Limited will be as mutually agreed upon between the Ministry of Telecommunications and the Great Northern Telegraph Company, Limited, and negotiated in accordance with the provisions of reference memorandum 1b above.
4. Direct communication between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Telecommunications, concerning matters within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.BUSH
Brigadier General, USA
Adjutant General
